name: Publish VS Code extension
# GITHUB_TOKEN-created releases suppress release events. Resolve only the
# published tag from a completed main run; no fork head is executed here.
on: # zizmor: ignore[dangerous-triggers]
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["CI/CD Pipeline"]
    types: [completed]
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches-ignore: ['e2e/**']
    paths:
      - "js/**"
      - "vscode/**"
      - "data/seed/**"
      - "package.json"
      - "bun.lock"
      - ".github/workflows/publish-vscode.yml"
      - "scripts/resolve-package-release.mjs"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: Run package checks without publication
        type: choice
        options: [checks]
        default: checks
      pull-request:
        description: Pull request whose package checks were dispatched
        type: string
        default: ''
      publish:
        description: Publish the selected stable release (main only)
        type: boolean
        default: false
      tag:
        description: Published release tag (empty selects the latest)
        type: string
        default: ''
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: publish-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  resolve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    if: >-
      github.event_name != 'workflow_run' ||
      (github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == 'main' &&
       github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository &&
       github.event.workflow_run.conclusion != 'cancelled' &&
       github.event.workflow_run.conclusion != 'skipped')
    outputs:
      tag: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
      publish: ${{ steps.release.outputs.publish }}
      build: ${{ steps.release.outputs.build }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24.x'
      - name: Resolve the published package release
        id: release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          REFERENCE: ${{ github.ref }}
          PUBLISH: ${{ inputs.publish }}
          INPUT_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
          RUN_HEAD: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          RUN_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}
          RUN_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name }}
          RUN_CONCLUSION: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.conclusion }}
        run: node scripts/resolve-package-release.mjs
  publish:
    needs: resolve
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && needs.resolve.outputs.build == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Select the resolved release tag
        if: needs.resolve.outputs.tag != ''
        env:
          PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]] || exit 1
          git fetch origin "refs/tags/$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG:refs/tags/$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG"
          git checkout --detach "refs/tags/$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG"
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24.x'
      - name: Install Bun
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          echo "$HOME/.bun/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - name: Build web resources and extension
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
          export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
          bun install --frozen-lockfile
          bun run build:web
          npm ci --prefix vscode --no-audit --no-fund
          npm --prefix vscode run package
      - name: Compare the packaged extension version with the preceding release
        id: version
        run: |
          current=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("vscode/package.json"))["version"])')
          previous_tag=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 HEAD^ 2>/dev/null || true)
          previous=''
          if [ -n "$previous_tag" ]; then
            git show "$previous_tag:vscode/package.json" > /tmp/previous-extension.json
            previous=$(python3 -c 'import json; print(json.load(open("/tmp/previous-extension.json"))["version"])')
          fi
          echo "current=$current" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          if [ "$current" != "$previous" ]; then echo 'changed=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; else echo 'changed=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: formal-ai-vscode
          path: vscode/*.vsix
          if-no-files-found: error
      - name: Run existing extension checks
        run: npm --prefix vscode test
      - name: Attach installable extension package to the release
        if: needs.resolve.outputs.publish == 'true'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.resolve.outputs.tag }}
        run: gh release upload "$PACKAGE_RELEASE_TAG" vscode/*.vsix --clobber
      - name: Publish Marketplace
        if: needs.resolve.outputs.publish == 'true' && steps.version.outputs.changed == 'true'
        working-directory: vscode
        env:
          VSCE_PAT: ${{ secrets.VSCE_PAT }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$VSCE_PAT" ]; then echo 'Marketplace publishing unavailable: VSCE_PAT is not configured'; exit 0; fi
          npx --no-install vsce publish --packagePath ./*.vsix
      - name: Publish Open VSX
        if: needs.resolve.outputs.publish == 'true' && steps.version.outputs.changed == 'true'
        working-directory: vscode
        env:
          OVSX_PAT: ${{ secrets.OVSX_PAT }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$OVSX_PAT" ]; then echo 'Open VSX publishing unavailable: OVSX_PAT is not configured'; exit 0; fi
          npx --yes ovsx@1.2.0 publish ./*.vsix
      - name: Install published Marketplace extension in a clean profile
        if: needs.resolve.outputs.publish == 'true' && steps.version.outputs.changed == 'true'
        env:
          VSCE_PAT: ${{ secrets.VSCE_PAT }}
          EXPECTED_VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.current }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$VSCE_PAT" ]; then echo 'Install-by-id smoke unavailable: publication was not configured'; exit 0; fi
          curl -fsSL https://update.code.visualstudio.com/latest/linux-x64/stable -o /tmp/vscode.tar.gz
          mkdir /tmp/formal-ai-clean-vscode
          tar -xzf /tmp/vscode.tar.gz -C /tmp/formal-ai-clean-vscode --strip-components=1
          code=/tmp/formal-ai-clean-vscode/bin/code
          for _ in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            "$code" --no-sandbox --user-data-dir /tmp/formal-ai-vscode-profile --extensions-dir /tmp/formal-ai-vscode-extensions --install-extension link-assistant.formal-ai-vscode --force
            if "$code" --no-sandbox --user-data-dir /tmp/formal-ai-vscode-profile --extensions-dir /tmp/formal-ai-vscode-extensions --list-extensions --show-versions | grep -Fx "link-assistant.formal-ai-vscode@$EXPECTED_VERSION"; then exit 0; fi
            sleep 15
          done
          echo 'Published version did not become installable by id'; exit 1
